d: Spacious terrapieno in the fortress. You can see some belts, towers and other species of fortifications with drawbridges etc.From a distance you can see very picturesque mountains, which make beautiful and solemn view; while the sun, which is born, is gradually illuminating them, as then it illuminates the whole scene. Above the bulwarks you can see exchanging the sentries. Sentinels outside and inside the fortress, Bruno and choir of Soldati.
Choir of Castellane and Castellani, which carry baskets of flowers.
Rooms of Elvira. Gothic windows are open: you can see fortifications, etc. Elvira, and Sir George.

Armor room with large loggias, where the Gothic architecture shows its entire pump. The bottom of the scene is open. Among the columns you can always see some traces of the fortifications, etc.Elvira, Valton, Sir Giorgio, Lord Arturo, Bruno.
Arturo, Valton, Giorgio, Elvira, then Bruno and Enrichetta.
Riccardo, then Valton, Bruno, Elvira with Damigelle in a wedding pump. Indi Soldati, Puritani, Castellani and Castellane.
Great hall with side doors: see for one of them the English field and always some fortifications. Castellani and Castellane, Puritans and Bruno.
Giorgio from the apartments of Elvira; then Riccardo with sheet.
George looks around; then grabs for the Riccardo arm as one who speaks shows know one of his grave secrets.

Loggia in a garden and grove near the house of Elvira: this house has the door and windows with very transparent glass. From a distance you can always see some fortifications, etc. The day begins to darken. - A hurricane rises, and while more raging, I heard inside the scenes and from a distance some alarm shouts and a blow of archibugio. - Shortly after Arturo appears wrapped in a large cloak. Gradually the moon comes out. The house inside seen by various illuminated lamps. Arturo, and then Elvira.
Elvira, and Arturo in the background.
Riccardo, Giorgio, Bruno, Armigeri, with facelles, Castellani, and Castellane.
